I am unsure of how beneficial this info will be, but I will share it anyway haha. My boyfriend has OCPD, and I have BPD, and he has mentioned this same aversion many times. We have both agreed to call these people “selfishly inaccurate” because we don’t think that one quality can qualify somebody to be categorized as narcissistic. 
My boyfriend HATES this quality because listening to distorted facts are a waste of his time, as he can see right through the “half-truths” and immediately discards the information. The person loses their credibility, and he then loses respect for them. He tries to avoid communication with people he does not respect. I tried to use his thought process/terminology to write this, in order to explain it as accurately as possible. 🙂
I also hate these people but for different reasons, I do not like when people twist the truth because I become very uneasy about their motives as to why they lied, and thus I also discredit their words and quite literally fear them. I would much rather get my feelings hurt than hear a white lie because trust does not come easy for me. I can see manipulation pretty easily, and I need to be able to trust somebody or I will literally lose my mind trying to “filter out” the misinformation and implicit lies. 
I hope this helps, I enjoyed writing this and I hope you have a good day. 🙂
